Method of Attack: Remote Access Trojan (RAT) enabling data theft including contacts, call logs, SMS messages
Intercepting and extracting messages from encrypted apps like WhatsApp and Signal
Searching and exfiltrating documents, images, audio, and other files
Attack Vector: Malicious Android applications disguised as messaging or news apps available on Google Play and third-party app stores
Fake messaging apps distributed via romance scams
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious apps names: Rafaqat, Privee Talk, MeetMe, Let's Chat, Quick Chat, Chit Chat, Hello Chat, YohooTalk, TikTalk, Nidus, GlowChat, Wave Chat
Downloaded roughly 1,400 times from Google Play (VajraSpy apps)
